_meta.source: npcId/nameEn/nameKo/displayId cross-checked against AzerothCore creature_template + creature_template_model + creature_template_locale(koKR) (3.3.5 data, vanilla entries unchanged). displayIds above 16700 (TBC/WotLK remodels) were dropped to null so the addon falls back to SetCreature(npcId).
_meta.confidence: high = id+name verified, display in vanilla range; medium = id verified but displayId null or row is a WotLK-rescaled copy; low = unverified
_meta.nameKo: Korean names from the koKR client locale (3.3.5); Classic-era KR client may differ slightly for a few names.
_meta.loadingScreen: 1.x vanilla 5-man dungeons and open zones use the continent screen (LoadScreenEasternKingdom / LoadScreenKalimdor); instance-specific screens only where 1.x had one. Paths are case-insensitive in the client. loadingScreenConfidence is separate from creature-id confidence.
